findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Gate: proof list
Case: normal use - the pull-request change test validates the release proof.
The proof list names test_2 and test_3 from this modified test file. `src/forge/proof.py:316–330` treats both as changed regression tests and replays them on the v1.2.49 base. In particular, `tests/test_release_version.py:81–84` derives the notes filename from the old executable, so test_3 finds the existing v1.2.49 notes and passes before the fix. The replay rejects a named test that passes on the base (`src/forge/proof.py:352–370`), causing the required change-test job to fail even if the release tests pass on this branch.
findings.title: Gate: pre-fix replay rejects the reused release-version proofs

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Gate: proof list
Case: normal use - close checks whether the v1.2.50 release is ready.
The Done-when requires the release-notes tests to pass, but the proof list names only `test_1_the_release_tag_push_needs_notes_that_cover_the_shipped_files`. `tests/test_release_notes.py:58`, `:138`, and `:185` also contain the guide, upgrade, and `forge next` release-notes tests. The change-test picker can retain only the named case when the unchanged file is not otherwise selected (`src/forge/fasttest.py:519–538`), and the proof checker verifies only mapped names (`src/forge/proof.py:203–235`). Thus the proof does not require those remaining tests to run or pass.
